title: Import data
hint: Bring your products, customers, suppliers, staff and opening stock in from spreadsheets.
emptyHint: Start with your products, then customers, suppliers and opening stock.
noKindsHint: Ask the owner to switch on Products, Customers or another part of Ziira, and to give you permission to create that data.

upload.whatHint: Import products before opening stock, because stock is matched to products by their SKU.
upload.fileHint: A CSV file saved from Excel or exported from your old system. The first row must be the column names.
upload.decimalHint: Look at a price in your file, for example 1,250.50 or 1.250,50.
upload.datesHint: Only matters if the file has dates.
upload.pickHint: Up to 5 MB and 5,000 rows. For more, split the file.
upload.notReversible: Records created by an import cannot be deleted. Check the file carefully before importing.

map.title: Match your columns
map.hint: {{file}} has {{count}} rows. Tell us which column holds each field; we have guessed where we could. Fields marked * are needed.
map.duplicated: A column can fill only one field: {{columns}}
map.preview: The first rows of your file
map.previewHint: The first {{count}} rows, as we read them.

review.nothingNew: Everything in this file is already in Ziira, so there is nothing to import.
review.nothingReady: No row can be imported yet. Fix the problems in your file and upload it again, or change the columns.
review.leftOut: {{count}} row(s) with problems will be left out. Download them, fix them and upload just those later.
review.confirm: {{count}} rows will be added to Ziira. Rows with problems and rows already in Ziira are left alone.
review.noUndo: Imported records cannot be deleted, so be sure the file is right.

progress.title: Importing
progress.hint: This runs in the background. You can leave this page and come back; nothing is lost.

report.title: Does it add up?
report.hint: Your file had {{rows}} rows. Each figure is added up in your file and again from what is now in Ziira.
report.noTotals: This kind of file has no money or quantity columns to add up. Check the counts above.
report.reconciled: Everything imported adds up to your file.

guide.title: Moving your business onto Ziira
guide.hint: The imports in the order that works, with what each one needs and where it stands.
guide.beforeHint: set up your units of measure and tax codes, and check each file with a trial run before you import it for real.

setup.title: Units and tax codes
setup.text: Check the units of measure and tax codes that products use.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.text: Your accounts, so the books can be opened.

products.title: Products
products.text: Your catalogue with SKUs, units and prices.

customers.title: Customers
customers.text: Who you sell to, with their contact details.

opening_stock.title: Opening stock
opening_stock.text: What each store holds today, with its cost. Import products first.

customer_balances.title: Customer balances
customer_balances.text: What customers owe you today, invoice by invoice.

supplier_balances.title: Supplier balances
supplier_balances.text: What you owe suppliers today, bill by bill.

opening_trial_balance.title: Opening trial balance
opening_trial_balance.text: The balance of every account on your start date, as the last step.
